Features Map

Tools for tender and procurement teams

Keep tender review, company documents, and team follow-up together.

Tender summary

Generates a business synopsis in minutes instead of reading 500 pages.

Clause Intelligence

Identifies EMD, turnovers, and machinery requisites with page citations.

Eligibility Analysis

Computes matching passes or warnings against active corporate parameters.

Company Profile Matching

Highlights capabilities deficits before committing proposal resources.

Risk Intelligence

Flags timeline penalties, liquid assets caps, and contract vulnerabilities.

Bid Readiness Score

Assesses capability matching metrics to flag target readiness percentages.

Document Checklist

Checks document validity logs to flag renewals or missing credentials.

Corrigendum Tracker

Tracks addenda modifications, highlighting altered deadlines or EMDs.

Tender Discovery

Search governmental portal datasets like NHAI and DMRC inside one panel.

Tender Q&A

Prompt the copilot directly for specific clauses, terms, and requirements.

Executive Reports

Downloads professional analysis files for bidding committee review.

Tender Analytics

Visualizes historical win distributions and eligibility matching ratios.
